notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Missed us? 😈 

We are coming with some newest graphics today. 

Subway station might look safe, but is it? Are you sure you'll make it to the next stop? Remember this place, you'll get there, even without your ticket...

This is the first location we are sharing with you. Be sure to come back next week for some more! Promise, we'll be much more often here now.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to our first ever devlog! [/h1]

We at Black Rose Projects are working 24/7 on Dark Moonlight and would like to share our progress with you. Development of the game is going according to plan, new levels and enemies are currently being built. Stay tuned for regular updates and production highlights. A lot of dark fun ahead of us, so let's stay in touch!
